data.one_liner: Voice message playback widget with animated waveform, speed controls, and user avatars.
data.what_it_does: Provides a customizable voice message player widget for chat applications with play/pause controls, interactive seek bars, speed adjustment, and animated wave visualizers. Supports multiple audio sources including URLs, local files, and byte arrays.
use_when: You are building a chat application and need to display voice messages.
You require customizable voice waveforms and playback speed controls.
avoid_when: You need background audio playback or a full-featured music player.
You are recording audio rather than playing it back.
strengths: Includes animated waveform visualization and interactive seeking.
Supports speed control, avatars, and extensive styling configurations.
Cross-platform support across mobile, web, and desktop.
weaknesses: Seeking is not supported when loading audio from byte sources.
Strictly tailored for chat voice messages rather than general audio streaming.
data.setup_notes: Requires v_platform as a dependency alongside v_chat_voice_player.

alternatives.name: just_audio
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need a robust, low-level audio player for general audio streaming, playlists, or complex audio routing instead of a pre-built chat voice widget.

alternatives.name: audioplayers
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want a simple multi-platform audio player plugin to implement custom audio interfaces from scratch.
